name: Terry Bogard
source: A street smart, charismatic and playful man who is friendly to all who meet him except the irredeemable and malicious. Originating from Fatal Fury, Terry along with his younger brother Andy lost his adoptive father at a young age. This spurred him to spend a decade being trained by his father's mentor. He loves browsing the net and is somewhat of a freeter. Tends to pepper in English phrases.
